030package dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products;
031
032import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
033import java.sql.Connection;
034import java.sql.DatabaseMetaData;
035import java.sql.SQLException;
036import java.util.Collection;
037
038import org.openide.util.lookup.Lookups;
039
040import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.DbSupport;
041import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.CentralLookup;
042import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
043import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils;
044
045import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.ERROR;
046
047/**
048 * Generate DbSupport instances;
049 * Searches for classes that can create them.
050 * See {@link DbSupportCreator}.
051 */
052// Would be nice to have this run automatically. Might need a "using" method
053// somewhere that initializes database related stuff.
054public class DbSupportFactory {
055  private DbSupportFactory() {}
056  private static final System.Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
057
058  /**
059   * Create a DbSupport that works with the specified connection according
060   * to its metadata; put it into the CentralLookup.
061   * It replaces any
062   * {@code DbSupport} that might already be in there.
063   * See {@link SsUtils#dbSupport()} for best access method.
064   * The connection is used as the shared connection and to
065   * examine DatabaseMetaData.
066   * @param sharedConnection
067   * @return an DbSupport instance that is put into CentralLookup or null.
068   */
069  public static DbSupport addDbSupportToLookup(Connection sharedConnection) {
070    DbSupport dbSupport = createDbSupport(sharedConnection);
071    if (dbSupport != null)
072      CentralLookup.getDefault().replace(DbSupport.class, dbSupport);
073    return dbSupport;
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Create a DbSupport that works with the specified connection according
078   * to its metadata.
079   * The connection is used as the shared connection and to
080   * examine DatabaseMetaData.
081   * @param sharedConnection
082   * @return an DbSupport instance that is put into CentralLookup or null.
083   */
084  public static DbSupport createDbSupport(Connection sharedConnection) {
085    DatabaseMetaData dbMeta;
086    String productName;
087    try {
088      dbMeta = sharedConnection.getMetaData();
089      productName = dbMeta.getDatabaseProductName();
090    } catch (SQLException ex) {
091      logger.log(ERROR, (String) null, ex);
092      return null;
093    }
094    logger.log(Level.INFO, () -> "Creating DbSupport for " + productName);
095    Collection<? extends DbSupportCreator> creators
096        = Lookups.forPath("SS/DbSupport/" + productName).lookupAll(DbSupportCreator.class);
097    if (creators.isEmpty())
098      logger.log(ERROR, () -> "No DbSupportCreator for " + productName);
099
100    DbSupport dbSupport = null;
101    for (DbSupportCreator creator : creators) {
102      if ((dbSupport = creator.create(sharedConnection, dbMeta)) != null)
103        break;
104    }
105    if (dbSupport == null) {
106      logger.log(ERROR, () -> "Failed to create DbSupport for " + productName);
107      return null;
108    }
109    return dbSupport;
110  }
111}
